mentions.name: ViewMD
mentions.description: This app is a Markdown viewer for Mac optimized for AI coding workflows with tools like Claude. It supports all Markdown formatting, diagrams (e.g. ER and state-transition diagrams), math notation, file links, and includes a table of contents feature.
mentions.audience: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude
mentions.source_excerpt: I have built a Markdown Viewer for Mac which is optimised for AI coding with the likes of Claude.
